profile.name: Daniel Mafukidze
profile.title: Business Process Automation Specialist · Data Analyst · Cyber Security Enthusiast · System Administrator · Solution Builder · Product Developer · System Analyst
profile.summary: I work where the technical side and the commercial side of a deal need to line up. Since 2018 I have implemented and supported ERP, CRM and SaaS platforms (Zoho, Odoo, Palladium, Pastel, CaseWare, Kofax, WAERlinx) across AWS and Google Cloud, and trained the people who use them. Today I help Zimbabwean businesses choose the right technology as an Account Manager at Frolgate Technology Group. After hours I build and ship my own products, including a freight marketplace, an AI safety-vision system and an omnichannel contact centre, all deployed through my own CI/CD pipeline.

IT cost savings identified across departments

points: Own a portfolio of B2B technology accounts end to end, from lead generation and needs analysis to close and renewal.
Prescribe best-fit solutions across ERP, cloud, unified communications, contact centre, AV and cybersecurity, and build proposals and quotations with the technical team.
Respond to public tenders and RFPs on the PRAZ eGP system, and built my own tender-intelligence tooling to find them first.
Act as the customer’s voice inside the business, turning client feedback into solutions with engineering.
Configured and deployed CaseWare, Kofax (Tungsten) and Zoho for client environments.
Designed training programmes, manuals and live sessions that lifted on-time project delivery by 15%.
Ran onboarding from data migration and Google Cloud sandbox/production setup through UAT to go-live, with 99%+ uptime.
Found upsell opportunities in Zoho CRM data, adding 5% to lead generation and the proposal pipeline.
Administered Zoho ERP and CaseWare cloud infrastructure, targeting 99% availability.
Managed Google Cloud environments and provided Tier-2 support for Kofax intelligent automation.
Put backup and disaster-recovery protocols in place across servers, network and security systems.
Identified IT cost savings of up to 30% through financial analysis across departments.
Led the Pastel ERP and Microsoft 365 rollout, raising productivity by 30% through change management and training.
Ran on-premise servers, VPNs and network security, and supported staff on-site and remotely.
Deployed anti-phishing and ransomware defences and achieved a 100% backup-recovery success rate.
Introduced IT asset inventory control that ended duplicated purchases.
Implemented and supported WAERlinx, a B2B SaaS supply-chain and warehouse platform: customisation, API configuration and client-specific features.
Troubleshot client Linux VMs on AWS and Google Cloud, reading the Java codebase to trace root causes.
Ran UAT and QA before every release, tracked work in JIRA and followed SOC 1 requirements.
Led the migration from Sage to Palladium ERP with a zero-disruption go-live.
Moved mailboxes to Exchange Online, rolled out Microsoft 365 and Azure AD, and migrated MSSQL to the cloud.
Implemented VoIP call tracking and recording, a VPN with failover, and a staffed IT helpdesk.
Built a custom internet user-management tool, ran cyber-awareness training and produced Tableau reports for sales and finance.
Tested Paynow payment-gateway integrations in PHP, C# and Java, validating HTTP request and response flows.
Handled high-volume customer queries through ticketing systems.

projects.name: HaulMate
projects.description: An inDrive-style marketplace that connects shippers with truck owners for loads from a pickup up to 30 tonnes. Shippers set a price (with a recommended fare), drivers accept loads, and both sides track the trip live.
features: Live GPS tracking, in-app chat and voice calls
Driver KYC with ID OCR and liveness checks
Paynow payments managed from the admin console
Android and iOS apps for shippers and drivers; admin on web and mobile

projects.name: Frol-Pulse
projects.description: An omnichannel contact-centre platform. It began as real-time wallboards and reporting for IP telephony and contact-centre systems and is growing into a full contact centre of its own.
features: Real-time wallboards and detailed historical reporting
Own voice engine (Kamailio + Asterisk): any SIP trunk, agent extensions, prebuilt PBX connectors
AI IVR, AI virtual assistant and agent gamification on the roadmap
Primary server with automatic disaster-recovery failover

projects.name: PPE Guard
projects.description: Computer vision that checks every person on site for a helmet, vest, gloves, boots and goggles. Compliant workers get a green box, missing items are highlighted in red, and supervisors are alerted immediately.
features: Works with webcams, video files and CCTV/RTSP streams
Browser, email and WhatsApp alerts with evidence snapshots
Own detection model with active learning: uncertain frames are reviewed, retrained on Kaggle GPUs and hot-swapped with zero downtime
Built for construction sites, factories and mines

projects.name: PBX ↔ CRM Connector
projects.description: A custom CTI connector between Avaya IP Office and Bitrix24 CRM. A Node.js service listens to the phone system’s DevLink3 event stream and turns calls into CRM activity in real time.
features: Caller screen-pops and automatic call logging in the CRM
OAuth handler on the VPS, with middleware on the LAN next to the PBX
Groundwork for an omnichannel contact centre inside the CRM

projects.name: OptiPlan
projects.description: Finds sales opportunities before competitors do. It pulls live tenders, annual procurement plans and award notices from Zimbabwe’s PRAZ eGP system and sorts them by product portfolio.
features: Spring Boot web app with a portfolio-sorted opportunity board
Companion Odoo 18 modules: a tender scraper that pushes to the CRM with email alerts, plus a weekly pipeline sync
Category codes managed from the UI

projects.name: WhatsApp → CRM Bridge
projects.description: Node.js middleware that turns WhatsApp conversations into structured CRM case records, with automated triage, routing and SLA escalation on Bitrix24 Smart Process Automation.
features: Maps WhatsApp Open Channel conversations to case records
Automation robots for triage, routing and SLA escalation
Hosted on the VPS behind a reverse proxy

projects.name: Content Automation
projects.description: Blog Agent is a Django app that suggests topics, drafts posts with Google Gemini, generates images and runs a review-and-schedule workflow. It works alongside n8n pipelines for blog and LinkedIn content.
features: Topic suggestions, AI drafting and image generation
Human review and scheduling before anything is published
n8n workflows chaining Apify, Gemini, Google Docs and Slack

projects.name: Nexigent Labs
projects.description: My own cloud lab on a Contabo VPS, which also hosts this portfolio. Every project is pushed to Git, built by Jenkins into a Docker image and served behind Nginx Proxy Manager over HTTPS.
features: Jenkins pipelines that build and deploy Docker containers
Nginx Proxy Manager, PostgreSQL, a mailcow mail server, n8n, Odoo, Metabase and Plane
3CX PBX in Docker for telephony labs

projects.name: Data Dashboards
projects.description: Data analysis and visualisation work in Python and Tableau, published on Tableau Public.
features: Value Inc sales dashboard
BlogMe news engagement dashboard
Blue Bank loan-portfolio dashboard
